subject: Data Engineering
title: Serverless Data Services
description: A micro-lesson that makes Serverless Data Services usable.

hook.text: You run a query. You pay for the bytes scanned. No clusters to manage. No idle servers burning money.

buildup.text: Serverless services abstract away all infrastructure. You send work; the platform handles the rest.

discovery.text: BigQuery, Athena, and Azure Synapse Serverless all offer query engines with zero infrastructure management.

twist.text: Serverless costs can spike unpredictably. A badly written query scanning 10 TB costs hundreds of dollars.

climax.text: Serverless is ideal for unpredictable workloads but requires cost monitoring and query governance.

punchline.text: No servers to manage. But watch the bill.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of serverless data services?
options: They are too slow for production
